verdict.rationale: Convex calls itself "the open source, reactive database." Its self-hosting docs say the self-hosted build runs the open-source backend with the same up-to-date code as the cloud service. A public GitHub repo (get-convex/convex-backend) hosts that backend source. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named, there is no evidence on whether client libraries and dashboard are also open, and there is no independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
